unit: luma 0-255 (mean of the last prompt word ROI, drift-compensated)
sampling: captured pictures only (24/30 fps cadence on the 60 fps grid)
note: prompt bar streams its 7-word line word by word: the last word fades in while de-blurring (Gaussian sigma 5 -> 0 px) and rising 5 px (0.5% H), f1099-f1119; ROI shifted per frame by the measured bar drift (phase correlation); words 4-7 start 3-5 frames apart and each takes ~18 frames, so 3-4 words are mid-fade at once
